title: A power series ring over a Noetherian N-2 domain is a Noetherian N-2 domain
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] integral domain which is N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain], and let $R[[x]]$ be the ring of formal power series in one variable $x$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] (the case $n=1$). Then $R[[x]]$ is a Noetherian integral domain and $R[[x]]$ is N-2: for every finite field extension $L$ [def-pc-field-extension] of the fraction field of $R[[x]]$, the integral closure of $R[[x]]$ in $L$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] is a finitely generated $R[[x]]$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].
